query:
SELECT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp
				WHERE rp.role_id = $1
				AND rp.permission_id NOT IN (
					SELECT own.permission_id FROM team_members tm
					JOIN role_permissions own ON own.role_id = tm.role_id
					WHERE tm.team_id = $2 AND tm.user_id = $3
				)
			) AS "exists!"
